text:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm pushing the quant candidates for mpt-30b-v2 to staging now. Need fast sanity checks on weights location, tokenizer quirks, and config validation before we kick off AWQ/GPTQ runs.

sam: weights path pls? I'll verify checksum + permissions.

maya: path: `/srv/models/mpt-30b/v2/weights_v2.tar.gz`
sha256: `b3f6e9a2...4c1` (shorted here)
also there's an extracted folder at `/srv/models/mpt-30b/v2/weights/` with symlinked shards.

leo: tokenizer note — the training tokenizer has an extra special token `<|system|>` that isn't in main vocab. Decoding differences seen in a few system prompts. Need to confirm `tokenizer.json` used by serving includes that token mapping.

rachel: is that the same tokenizer id as prod? we should avoid token id drift for evals.

maya: prod id is `mpt-30b-tokenizer-v1`. candidate tokenizer file is `mpt-30b-tokenizer-v1.1.json` (adds the system token mapping). I added a compatibility shim in the staging transform but want a second set of eyes.

jon: for quant configs, what profiles are we running? AWQ + GPTQ + FP8 baseline?

maya: yes — run AWQ (conservative), GPTQ (default params), and FP8 simulated baseline. For AWQ I set `dropout_calib=false` to keep determinism.

maya: serving config snippet I'm using in staging:```json
{
  "model": "mpt-30b-v2",
  "quant_profile": "awq-conservative",
  "kv_cache": true,
  "max_seq": 1024,
  "batching": {
    "strategy": "dynamic",
    "max_tokens": 4096
  }
}
```

sam: config looks fine. confirm the `weights` owner/group is `inference:inference` and mode `640`? I can fix perms.

sam: also ran a quick `tar -tzf` on the archive — all shard files present (`shard-000.pt` ... `shard-023.pt`). checksums match on my side.

leo: tokenizer mapping check: I diffed token ids between v1 and v1.1 — only extra token appended at index 50432, so id-space shift unlikely. BUT the tokenizers have different `add_prefix_space` defaults — that could change tokenization on leading spaces. Recommend running a 1k prompt smoke test.

rachel: +1 to 1k smoke. Also we need calibration dataset size guidance — what are we using for AWQ/GPTQ?

maya: plan: use calibration set `calib-news-5k` (~5k examples, varied lengths). For AWQ we usually do 2k samples, but given new tokenizer quirks I'm proposing full 5k for stability.

jon: acceptance criteria: end-to-end generation quality drop <= 1.5% relative on the centennial eval set (perplexity) OR downstream F1 delta <= 2% on q/a bench. Also latency and memory must be within Dedicated SLO.

sam: can we add a perf smoke: generate 100 x 128-token samples and check p99 latency? I'll queue that after calib.

maya: FYI I've filed the quant run in the job queue: job id `qr-2026-0317-11` (staging).

deploy-bot: Scheduled quant job `qr-2026-0317-11` — AWQ,GPTQ,FP8 — runner: staging-cluster-7. ETA ~40m. :gear:

leo: quick note — fallback plan if AWQ has >3% quality regression: auto-fallback to GPTQ variant and flag for a canary traffic gate.

rachel: who needs to approve calibration start? I can sign off if checksums/tokenizer/perms are confirmed.

sam: checksums good, perms ok (fixed groups), shards verified.

maya: tokenizer shim applied in staging, smoke test queued (1k prompts), passing locally so far ~98% token parity.

rachel: ok — I approve starting the full calibration run. Please tag me with results and any regression diffs. :white_check_mark:

jon: pinging infra if perf p99 > target — @sam if that happens we throttle job.

maya: thanks all — starting the runs now (kicking off after the smoke completes). Will post final artifacts (calib tables, eval diffs, serving configs) here when done.

deploy-bot: Job `qr-2026-0317-11` started on staging-cluster-7. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/qr-2026-0317-11/logs

leo: noted — will monitor tokenizer edge-case logs for first 500 requests.

maya: (slash)cc @rachel @sam @leo — thanks for quick checks :thumbsup:

rachel: thanks, keeping an eye.
